lede: One name surfaced in two very different corners of the web today: Ben Shelton topped Wikipedia with about 434,000 views, while bettors on Polymarket priced his US Open match against Alexander Zverev, with Zverev the slight favorite. Builders, meanwhile, poured onto bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view, which pulled in more than 2,200 GitHub stars in a single day. On Steam, Counter-Strike 2 held the largest live crowd, with over 1.35 million players in game at once.

throughlines.title: Ben Shelton
throughlines.gist: A tennis story reaching past the court: he led Wikipedia's most-read list while Polymarket ran an active market on his US Open match with Alexander Zverev.

throughlines.title: bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view
throughlines.gist: A fast-rising open-source project that took the top of GitHub trending, adding roughly 2,300 stars in a single day.

throughlines.title: The Interim Computer Museum
throughlines.gist: A quiet passion project holding the front of Hacker News with 58 points and an early handful of comments.
